task.problem_summary: DSPy 2.5 TypedPredictor List[str] output works directly but BootstrapFewShot optimization reports JSONDecodeError trailing data and retries
task.original_production_example: CoNLL 2003 tokenization on hosted Databricks LM; no API credentials used in this study.

hypothesis: The original ChatAdapter formats List[str] output demonstration values as a multiline human-readable list even when TypedPredictor prepares a JSON parser for that output; when few-shot demos are introduced, formatting may bias model output away from valid JSON. This is a plausible mechanism, not a proven root cause of remote LM behavior.

visible_suite.source_import_mode: compile the complete original ChatAdapter and helper functions from exact original source AST, using import-only Adapter stub; Pydantic v2 TypeAdapter is real; no network LM inference.
preregistered_conditions: A typed List[str] output demo must be serialized as valid JSON array, not the plain generic list display format
A typed list[str] output demo must serialize consistently with typing.List[str]
A typed list of Pydantic BaseModel must remain roundtrip-valid JSON
Quoted strings, unicode, punctuation and empty typed lists must roundtrip
A non-TypedPredictor unparsed list output demo retains existing human-readable formatting
A list INPUT remains in existing input formatting (no collateral change)
A simple string output remains unchanged
Full original ChatAdapter format/parse with an input+typed list output demo must roundtrip via TypeAdapter
visible_suite.original_base_expected: Some originally unsupported typed JSON demo roundtrips fail; do not count infrastructure errors or changed tests as baseline defects

candidate_scope.proposed: Within assistant demonstration formatting only, when output field has a TypedPredictor parser and a list or tuple value, use pydantic.TypeAdapter(annotation).dump_json(value).decode() to ensure JSON representation. Keep untyped/inference and input demonstration formats unchanged.
candidate_scope.no_changes: No source other than that file, no benchmark test patch, no LM credentials, no changes to original task code base.
